deploy-bot: Deploy started — multi-target fanout -> runtime / api / console | env=prod | tag=release/2026-03-19 | commits: runtime@ab12c4, api@9f8d77, console@3e4b1a | wave=3/5

alice: Copy. Watching runtime healthchecks, will pin if canary flaky.

ben: Quick q — did the api change include the reduce-batching flag? might affect p95.

carla: Yes, turned on reduce-batching in staging earlier, saw ~5% p95 improvement. For prod I'm leaving it enabled for the canary. @alice we should keep rollback plan ready.

deploy-bot: CANARY UPDATE: runtime canary 1/3 nodes OK. api canary 1/3 nodes FAILED with 503s (rate-limit spike). console canary pending.

dave: Pulling api from the wave. Pinning api to api@9f8d77 for now, rollback candidate api@9f8d00 if retry fails. @ben can you scrub logs?

ben: On it. Tailing logs now — seeing auth upstream reconnect errors around 1995432165, correlates with 503 spikes. Opening an incident thread.

alice: Runtime looks healthy, latency stable. Hold on console rollout until api stabilizes.

deploy-bot: ACTION: retrying api canary wave. Current state: 2/3 ok, 1/3 still 503. Decision needed: proceed or rollback? Options: wait 5m+retry, or immediate rollback to safe tag.

carla: :thinking_face: prefer wait 5m and retry once. If still flapping, rollback. Applying manual pin: api -> api@9f8d77 for next hour.

dave: Agree. Pin set and extra logging enabled on the problematic node.

deploy-bot: PIN APPLIED: api pinned to api@9f8d77. Wave paused by manual hold. No automated actions until manual resume. Please ack.

alice: :thumbsup: ack. I'll escalate and call rollback if error rate >2% sustained for 10m.

ben: Auth upstream showing slow reconnect pattern; if it recovers we can continue. Will report back in 3m.

deploy-bot: Manual resume requested by @alice at 1995432380. Proceeding with remaining fanout -> runtime / api / console. Final statuses: runtime=success, api=success, console=success. Deploy finished at 1995432430. Release notes: tag=release/2026-03-19; pinned components: api@9f8d77, runtime@ab12c4.

carla: Nice. Pushing brief summary to #release-notes and closing the incident.

dave: Good run. Will follow up with a short postmortem if auth upstream shows recurrence.

ben: Closing logs for this wave, adding correlation traces to the deploy record.
